promptZh: 邀请朋友参加阅读社团：说明时间、地点和需要带一本书。当前是短文入门任务。

explanation.summaryZh: 先说明邀请目的，再写活动信息，最后表达期待。
explanation.ruleZh: 确保读者知道何时、何地、做什么。

modelAnswer: Dear Alex, I would like to invite you to our school reading club. We meet in Room 203 after school on Friday. Please bring a book you like. We can share stories together. I hope you can join us. Yours, Li Hua
